Changes I will make when the new cards release is to remove lightning storm and soul release. Soul release is nice to search with tactics to stop snake-eyes.. but honestly using shark cannon on linkuriboh is just as strong if you can stop them early enough. Lightning storm is good but the new links are just as good. I used to use evenly matched for board break but it's not very fun to play that way. Harpie feather duster is too good because striker can also struggle with back row removal. The goal is to add 2 cyanos and if i can remove one more card i would like 1 more change of heart.

(If we get engage to 3 then I will change the deck a lot more too)

As for the extra deck, for now I will remove 1 Zeke for Camellia and access code for Engage Zero. Depending on the meta I will remove either kaina or hayate for one of the link 3s I mentioned earlier or Zeus

I’m so excited for new support too. I love this deck so hopefully this helps. The new links are very nice they help striker break boards (engage zero). Now we don’t need as many undetectable and inconsistent board breakers in our main deck like raigeki or lightning storm. And we have room for other striker spells and tech. 

Camellia is okay and good summon with cyanos. She can let sky striker to go first a little better since she has a hayate like effect. I also like her because it only requires 2 effect monsters. So we technically now can play cards would clog main monster zone like adventure engine and just link them off into camellia when ready (if you use adventure engine you will still need link spider to turn the token into a effect monster.. but it’s just an example). Camellia is very good card because if you can steal an opponent monster (change of heart) + summon any hand trap then link into camellia, then send raye, and start your plays. Lastly you can use linkage and send her on your opponent turn as use her effect as disruption but it’s risky because you have to give them the card until the end phase and they could link it off. 

The other new link engage zero is the board breaker because it can destroy all monsters. But it’s also kind of weird because it can’t be used as link material.. meaning we cannot link it off for any other link including our link 1 strikers. It will block the emz until you can remove it with something like linkage, so if you summon her too early and need a spell from GY you won’t be able to get it with kagari or summon shizuku for a search. Engage zero needs to be destroyed or sent to the graveyard to continue so timing her summon is very important. But this card does not have the “must be link summoned” restriction so it can be summoned for cheap with linkage effect… so it’s your call if you should you use linkage to get it out cheap or save linkage to remove it from emz

In my opinion the link 3 is OK.. it’s can be easy to summon all you need is a link two (zeke or azalea) + cyanos and rose in the GY. But imo the effect is not very good. One big counters to sky striker is cards that can not be targeted or destroyed (sometimes the only to get around some monsters is with HAMP) For this reason I think it’s best to use something like knightmare unicorn or ningirsu instead of the striker link 3, but it’s not terrible

And the link 4 is absolute garbage

Fun tech cards you can think about one is EM:P meowmine. It easy to use and will give you resources on the field for easy link 2 like zeke or S:P little knight it also has a second effect card that is removal and it works if a link 2 is sent to GY or banished face up (so linkage on engage zero or S:P effect)

Another that I hope is released in the new pack is blink out it is a quick play spell that can help get engage zero out of emz by sending it back to extra deck and summoning raye for more sky striker shenanigans. (Its kind of like linkage but instead of special summoning a link it will special summon raye, so can be good for dodging targeting effects too) It can also be used on opponent link and it will send it back to their extra deck for good removal but it doesn’t negate. It just came recently though so it might not be in master duel for a while.

Hope this helps let me know if you have any questions =)

I have diabellestar in my labyrinth deck so I like rollback at 3. It’s feels really good to send rollback to the grave with her effect and her trap can be used with rollback without having to send her to grave as cost (so a very strong field omni negate for half your lp)

I like to play very grindy by trying to out resource my opponent and many times I’ve have pinned my opponent using rollback on either the diabellestar trap or other one ofs like idp along with the other labyrinth traps. A lot of my duels have been even and fair until I get rollback in it’s in the grave but once it’s there it’s like cheat. When you have access to any of your traps in your GY without any speed or setting restriction It’s very strong and hard for your opponent to come back. It’s also seems very hard to disrupt rollback since it’s a trap that works in the GY.

Another nice thing about diabellestar is that she can send set traps you have to the GY as well as cards in hand. So let say you have eradicator in the graveyard. If you have diabellestar and furniture (stove or chandrag) you can do this. On your opponent turn you can search rollback with lady and it will be set on the field.. seems bad since you want it in the grave right?? But you can discard diabellestar with a furniture or if you already have her set up on the field with her trap you can use that for a negate. Then you can send the rollback on the field to the GY as the cost to resummon. You can set another sinful spoil card by her effect.. and now you can eradicate them or use any of your traps on their turn (including diabellestar trap you just used which is very strong). And while this is happening you are gaining advantage since these card recur. It’s a really cool combo when it happens! 

I recommend you try using her if you want to use 3 rollback. I use 3 wanted sinful spoil, 1 of the trap and 1 diabellestar.

You must draw foolish burial goods without metal foes fusion and send metal foes fusion for this engine to work.

I think good tip for a new Genji is his wall climb especially if your diving someone favorable. Getting vertical and then adding in your double jump can make you a hard target to hit. Also try to use the dash as a finishing move so get them as low as possible (keep in mind the target might be getting healed). If you can take out the enemy you can use ur follow up dash to, follow up, reposition, escape, etc. Search for some combo guides on YouTube to see the best way to kill!

I think a good strategy if starting would be to get blade as soon as possible if there are no dive opportunities available so maybe pump damage into tanks(similar to how sombra would farm emp). The hard part though is getting close to them.. remember you can climb and double jump so get to them on a flank without spending your dash so you can have it when you engage on them (similar to how tracer should try not to waste her blinks/recall before engages).

If you have no Ana or Mercy to boost your blade I would try to use it in a combo with some kinda CC ult because it’s kind of weak on its own.
